# Matt Pocock skill collection

Seven installed skills from or derived from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), pinned in [provenance.json](provenance.json). `codebase-design`, `domain-modeling`, and `writing-great-skills` are exact content snapshots. The other four are locally adapted source-family skills.

Keep this bundle together: `improve-codebase-architecture`, `wayfinder`, and `grilling` use companion vocabulary or workflows. The upstream [MIT licence](LICENSE) applies.

`writing-great-skills` is the meta-skill for turning repeatable knowledge into predictable skills: it explains invocation, information hierarchy, progressive disclosure, completion criteria, pruning, and failure modes.
